primary.title: ‘FY27 returns to be earnings driven with large caps in focus'
primary.summary: Large-caps, which underperformed small- and mid-caps owing to relatively lower earnings growth over several quarters, look set to capture investor attention, says Pratik Gupta, chief executive and co-head, Kotak Institutional Equities.
